title: Le Faux Soir (FCP 2026)
synopsis: November 1943, German-occupied Belgium. In the face of grave danger if caught, the Independent Front, a Belgian resistance organization, publishes a spoof edition of Le Soir to satirize the German occupiers and the nation’s main propaganda-controlled newspaper. Le Faux Soir is considered the first act of media hacking in history.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 1943年11月，德軍佔領下的比利時。比利時抵抗組織「獨立陣線」冒著一旦被揭發便性命不保的危險，出版了一份惡搞版的《晚報》(Le Soir)來諷刺德國佔領者以及國內那份受宣傳操控的主要報章。這份《偽晚報》(Le Faux Soir)被視為歷史上第一宗媒體黑客行動。
